tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: The tasks Local AI Picks lists open-weight models for (text LLM, coding, speech to text, text to speech, image, video, music, translation, OCR), with the number of current models and the page for each.

tools.name: find_models
tools.description: Current open-weight models for one task, latest version of each family, in the same order as the site. Give memory_gb (and device) to keep only models whose smallest listed weight option fits; memory is estimated only for text LLMs and taken from vendor sources otherwise, and is "unknown" when neith

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model: parameters, license, context length, every listed weight option with file size and memory need, third-party scores with their source and date, whether this site tested it, and links.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: The same facts as get_model for 2 to 4 models side by side.
